farms.name: Catfish Creek Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Catfish Creek Christmas Tree Farm has a rich history rooted in family tradition. The land was first purchased in 1974 by Gordon’s parents, where Gordon spent his childhood helping with farm life—selling eggs, raising chickens, and caring for horses.

In 2002, Gordon purchased the farm from his parents and began shaping it with his own vision. By 2009, alongside his wife Corinne, the couple planted and began maintaining 500 Christmas tree seedlings, laying the foundation for what would become a cherished holiday destination.

Today, Catfish Creek Christmas Tree Farm is proudly operated by Gordon, Corinne, and their son, combining the legacy of a traditional family farm with the magic of a Christmas tree farm. Each season, they provide their community with festive experiences, lasting memories, and the joy of finding the perfect Christmas tree.

farms.name: Carole's Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm has been family-owned and operated for more than 25 years, continuing a cherished tradition of offering a natural and memorable Christmas tree experience. Now in its ninth season under the current generation, the farm was built on the idea of recreating the timeless tradition of families strolling through forests in search of the perfect Christmas tree.

In 2023, Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm made the difficult decision to suspend its cut-your-own service. This change allows the farm to rehabilitate, while also addressing liability concerns and the increase in vandalism experienced during the 2022 season.

Dedicated to sustainability, Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm emphasizes the many benefits of real Christmas trees. Unlike artificial options, natural trees are renewable, biodegradable, and environmentally friendly—providing oxygen, shelter for wildlife, and the unmistakable fragrance of a true holiday tree.

Visitors are also invited to explore the Gift Shop, which offers an excellent selection of locally made, high-quality crafts perfect for gifting or decorating during the season.

Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm extends warm holiday wishes and looks forward to remaining a beloved part of local Christmas traditions for years to come.

farms.name: Briggs Trees
farms.description:
Briggs Tree Farm is a family-owned and operated farm that has been growing and selling Christmas trees to the Ottawa community for over 40 years. Nestled within a beautiful 100-acre woodland, the farm offers a traditional and memorable holiday experience where visitors can stroll through the forest to find their perfect tree.
The farm features a variety of trees ideal for Christmas, including Scotch Pine, Balsam Fir, White Spruce, and Norway Spruce. Each tree is carefully trimmed to maintain a natural shape, with a range of sizes and fullness to suit every home and holiday style.
Visitors are invited to enjoy a walk through the scenic woods, cut their own spruce, balsam, or scotch pine tree, and select a handcrafted natural Christmas wreath—making Briggs Tree Farm a festive destination for families year after year.

farms.name: Boisé Brabant
farms.description:
To enjoy the experience of cutting your own Christmas tree at Boisé Brabant, visitors are asked to book a date in advance at 721 Martel Rd. This system helps manage demand, reduce crowding, and ensure a safe, enjoyable visit for everyone, while also protecting the long-term sustainability of the tree plantation. Please note that the season is shorter this year, and trees will only be available while supplies last.

Boisé Brabant was founded in 2002 when Sylvie and Yvon embraced the chance to build something new as retirement approached. What began as a small Christmas tree venture has blossomed into both a family tradition and a local destination, where three generations now work together to welcome visitors each holiday season.

The farm offers an extensive selection of trees, from classics like Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir, White Spruce, and Blue Spruce to newly planted varieties including White Pine, Jack Pine, and Hemlock. For those seeking a more natural option, uncultivated spruce “wildlings” are also available at a reduced price. Sustainability is central to operations: no pesticides are used, and every tree harvested is replaced with new plantings by hand in the spring or fall.

In 2020, a sugar shack was added to the property, giving the family the ability to tap 325 red maples for small-batch maple syrup. This syrup is available throughout the year and during the Christmas tree season, adding a sweet tradition to the farm’s offerings.

At Boisé Brabant, guests will find more than just Christmas trees—they’ll discover a place where family values, nature, and holiday traditions come together to create lasting memories.

farms.name: Blue Harvest Farm
farms.description:
Blue Harvest Farm is more than a Christmas tree farm—it’s a place built to feel like home. Originally the family homestead, it is now run by the owner, her husband David, their children Blake and Samira, and their red retriever Elaina. Surrounded by beautiful views and breathtaking sunsets, the farm invites guests to experience the joy of choosing the perfect Christmas tree while creating lasting family memories.

Giving back has always been at the heart of Blue Harvest Farm. For many years, the family hosted an annual sale of one-of-a-kind garden trial plants to support local charities and their hospital. Today, that tradition of generosity continues with the Giving Tree Ornaments, where 100% of sales go directly toward helping local families enjoy a memorable Christmas.

During the holiday season, visitors can enjoy festive experiences including Santa’s visit, holiday crafts, gifts, seasonal décor, and Christmas photo opportunities—all designed to bring warmth, joy, and community spirit to every guest.

farms.name: Blitzen Estate
farms.description:
Blitzen Estate is a Christmas tree, maple syrup, and horse farm located in Jasper, Ontario, created by Caylyn and Kevin after leaving behind their fast-paced corporate careers. With backgrounds in health and safety management and corporate sales, the couple traded in global travel and high-stakes deals for small-town living and a farm that celebrates nature, tradition, and seasonal joy.

At Blitzen Estate, visitors will find more than just Christmas trees and maple syrup. Caylyn’s passion for horses brings unique experiences to the farm, with plans for sleigh rides, haunted hay rides, and other seasonal events that capture the festive spirit. Meanwhile, Kevin’s love for country living, combined with his people skills and storytelling, creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere for guests year-round.

With a focus on community, tradition, and creativity, Blitzen Estate is quickly becoming a local destination where families can gather, celebrate, and make memories in every season.

farms.name: BellyAcres Tree Farm
farms.description:
BellyAcres Tree Farm is a family-friendly destination where holiday traditions come alive. Conveniently located just off the main road, the farm makes it easy for families to choose and cut their own Christmas tree. Visitors often remark on the welcoming atmosphere, friendly staff, and the care Andrew and Louise take to ensure everyone has a memorable experience.

The farm offers a wide selection of well-trimmed pines and firs at reasonable prices, along with thoughtful touches such as saws, tree wrapping, and even candy-cane painted tools. Guests can enjoy the festive outdoor setting, warm up by the fire, and take home a beautiful fresh-cut tree to make their holiday season complete.

In addition to Christmas trees, BellyAcres Tree Farm is also home to pussy willows, available for seasonal decorating and traditions. With a commitment to environmentally friendly practices, the farm avoids chemicals and focuses on supporting the local community.

Whether it’s your first visit or part of a long-standing family tradition, BellyAcres Tree Farm is a place where memories are made, trees are fresh, and the holiday spirit thrives.

farms.name: Bastien Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Bastien Christmas Tree Farm has been family-owned and operated since 1995, proudly helping families create lasting holiday traditions. With approximately 15,000 trees at various stages of growth, including firs, spruces, and pines, the farm offers a wide selection of fresh Christmas trees for every home.

More than just a tree farm, Bastien Christmas Tree Farm is a destination for festive family outings. Guests can enjoy the nature trail, cozy campfire, photo centre, concession stand, and more, making each visit a memorable holiday experience.

Dedicated to keeping the spirit of Christmas alive, the Bastien family invites you to share in the joy of choosing a real tree and celebrating Christmas together.

farms.name: Barrett's Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Barrett’s Christmas Tree Farm opens for the season on November 29, 2025, welcoming families daily from 9am to 5pm through Christmas Eve. A family-owned farm rooted in tradition, Barrett’s offers both U-Cut and Pre-Cut Christmas trees, including premium Blue Spruce, with trees available in a variety of sizes. U-Cut trees up to 8ft are $62, with limited options above 8ft, while Pre-Cut trees range from $60–$110.

The farm is more than a place to find your perfect tree—it’s a holiday destination. Guests can enjoy the Family Fun Farm area (booking recommended), cozy up with hot chocolate or hot apple cider at the new Snack Shack, and indulge in treats like Grandma’s shortbread cookies, butter crunch chocolate, popcorn, and s’mores kits. On weekends, wagon rides run throughout the day, while horse-drawn wagon and sleigh rides add a magical touch for just $5 (weather permitting).

Families will also find plenty of festive activities: a play structure built by Bob for his kids in 1999, a bean bag toss game, and even a piece of aviation history—an authentic airplane displayed on the farm’s runway, restored to resemble a WWII Spitfire. Around the property, four campfire pits provide the perfect spot to warm up and roast marshmallows.

At Barrett’s Christmas Tree Farm, every detail—from hand-built benches to friendly staff—makes the experience more than just choosing a tree. It’s about creating family memories, celebrating the season, and enjoying a tradition that blends nature, history, and holiday fun.

farms.name: Bachner Family Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Bachner Family Christmas Tree Farm is rooted in a proud family tradition that began over 40 years ago, when Michael Bachner Sr. planted the farm’s very first Christmas trees. Today, four generations later, the Bachner family continues to carry on that legacy, nurturing trees with the same dedication and care that started it all.

The farm is committed to sustainable growth and hands-on care. Each tree is hand-trimmed in early summer, and with the help of irrigation, fertilization, and careful maintenance, the Bachners ensure that every tree grows healthy, full, and ready for families to enjoy. In April 2025, the farm introduced a new planting of Balsam–Fraser Fir cross trees, which will take several years to mature and offer even more variety for future generations.

For more than 35 years, Bachner Family Christmas Tree Farm has been providing the community with White Spruce, Fraser Fir, and other high-quality trees, grown with pride and care. With each new season, the family continues to strengthen its roots—both in the soil and in the community—ensuring that the tradition of bringing home a beautiful, fresh Christmas tree lives on for generations to come.
farms.varieties: White Spruce, Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir

farms.name: Dawson Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm is a family-owned and operated farm dedicated to making holiday traditions memorable. Located in Millbrook, ON, the farm offers a beautiful selection of Balsam, Fraser, and Douglas Fir trees, all professionally groomed and chemical-free, ensuring that every tree brought home is healthy, fresh, and ready to brighten the season.

Known for its friendly atmosphere and exceptional customer service, Crone’s has become a favorite for families looking to cut their own tree and enjoy a festive outing. Visitors can warm up by the fire, sip on hot chocolate, enjoy food and beverages from Muster Point, and take holiday photos to capture the day. The staff goes above and beyond to make every visit welcoming and memorable, creating a tradition families return to year after year.

With limited selection as the season progresses, guests are encouraged to come early for the best trees. At Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm, you’ll not only find the perfect tree—you’ll also find a place where community, holiday spirit, and family traditions flourish.

farms.name: Crone's Tree Farm
farms.description:
Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm is a family-run, chemical-free farm that has become a beloved holiday tradition for many. Visitors rave about the warm welcome they receive, the friendly atmosphere, and the simple joy of choosing and cutting their own Christmas tree.

The farm offers a wide variety of fir trees, from smaller family-sized options to towering 12-foot beauties—all priced affordably, with past seasons featuring deals like $50 for any size. Guests are provided with saws and bailing, and a tractor ride back to the parking area adds a fun, convenient touch to the outing.

Customers consistently highlight the farm’s professionally groomed, fresh trees and the wonderful family that runs it, making every visit feel personal and festive. Whether it’s your first time cutting your own tree or a tradition you look forward to each year, Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm offers the perfect mix of beautiful trees, fair prices, and heartfelt hospitality.

farms.name: Country Christmas Trees
farms.description: Country Christmas Trees is a women-owned, family-run tree farm known for its welcoming atmosphere, knowledgeable service, and high-quality selection of Christmas trees. The farm offers a diverse range of tree varieties, including some that are harder to find, along with handcrafted decorations such as wreaths and gnomes that are refreshed each year. Visitors consistently highlight the friendly and professional service, fair pricing, and the multi-generational family involvement in running the farm, from wreath-making to customer care. With beautiful trees, seasonal craftsmanship, and a tradition of hospitality, Country Christmas Trees has become a beloved destination for families looking to create lasting holiday memories.

farms.name: Copeman Tree Farms
farms.description:
Copeman Tree Farms is a family-run Christmas tree farm dedicated to growing premium-quality trees that are always fresh, beautifully fragrant, and carefully cultivated to last through the holiday season with proper care. Each tree is the result of more than a decade of attention and craftsmanship—taking approximately 12 years to mature, with the largest trees requiring up to 20 years of growth before reaching their full cathedral height.

Throughout the summer months, the family invests countless hours in shearing and pruning the trees into their iconic bushy, A-shaped form, ensuring a traditional and picturesque Christmas tree. In addition to offering trees, the farm welcomes visitors after the holidays to enjoy cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, sledding, and scenic walks among the snow-covered evergreens. With its blend of premium trees, careful cultivation, and year-round hospitality, Copeman Tree Farms provides families with both a festive holiday tradition and memorable outdoor experiences.

farms.name: Chickadee Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Chickadee Christmas Trees offers families an authentic, traditional Christmas tree experience in a scenic country setting. Established in 2002, the farm has grown from its first plantings in the late 1990s into a welcoming, family-run operation. Visitors can choose from quality pre-cut or cut-your-own trees and enjoy the festive atmosphere supported by family members, friends, and staff who help create a cheerful holiday tradition.

The farm is committed to environmental stewardship, dedicating land to reforestation, naturalized habitats, and pollinator-friendly practices. Chickadee also uses plastic-free, biodegradable netting for baling trees, ensuring an eco-friendly approach to Christmas traditions. With a focus on trees and greens such as wreaths and boughs, Chickadee Christmas Trees invites families to find their perfect tree while making lasting memories surrounded by the natural beauty of the farm.

farms.name: Cedar Hill Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Cedar Hill Christmas Tree Farm is a family-run operation rooted in the agricultural traditions of Cedar Hill since the 1820s. Originally established as a lumbering and sawmill property, the farm has served over the years as a dairy, beef, and sheep operation before expanding into fruit crops in 1978 and Christmas trees in 1988.

The farm is now owned and operated by the Martin family—Grant, Pam, Todd, Neil, Adam, and Graham—who bring with them a strong agricultural background, having previously managed an organic dairy farm before purchasing Cedar Hill in 2016. With decades of experience behind them and a commitment to quality, the Martins continue the legacy of producing beautiful Christmas trees for families across the region.

With deep local roots, multi-generational stewardship, and a focus on maintaining the land’s heritage, Cedar Hill Christmas Tree Farm offers both tradition and quality for those seeking the perfect tree during the holiday season.

farms.name: Drysdale's
farms.description:
Drysdale’s is a 4th-generation tree farm located in Egbert, Ontario, just an hour north of Toronto. Established in 1945 by Reginald Drysdale, the farm has grown into a well-known destination for Christmas trees, landscape trees, and memorable seasonal events.

Specializing in award-winning Christmas trees cultivated on its plantations since its founding, Drysdale’s offers a wide variety of mature trees direct from the grower, with optional delivery and installation services. For property owners, professional consultations are available to help select the ideal trees for beauty, privacy, and long-term growth.

Beyond its tree-growing legacy, Drysdale’s is also a venue for rustic weddings and other special events, providing a charming countryside setting for celebrations. While the farm no longer sells potted perennials and shrubs to the public, it remains committed to its core tradition—growing exceptional trees and helping families and communities create lasting memories.

farms.name: Georgian Bay Tree Farms
farms.description:
Georgian Bay Tree Farms is a family-friendly u-cut Christmas tree farm offering a wide selection of balsam fir, Fraser fir, and blue spruce trees at fair prices. Visitors are welcomed by friendly staff who provide guidance on parking, tree selection, and cutting, with wagon rides available to bring families and their trees back from the fields.

In addition to beautiful trees, the farm offers fresh wreaths for sale and a festive atmosphere that brings customers back year after year. Guests appreciate the reasonable pricing—such as $60 for a six-foot tree—the accommodating service, and the tradition of finding the “perfect tree” with loved ones. The farm is also pet-friendly, making it easy for the whole family, including dogs, to join the holiday outing.

With its welcoming staff, scenic property, and well-maintained trees, Georgian Bay Tree Farms has become a trusted local destination for creating lasting Christmas traditions. Visitors are encouraged to check the farm’s social media for up-to-date information, as it operates on select weekends leading up to Christmas.

farms.name: Whispering Willow Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Whispering Willow Christmas Tree Farm is a women-owned, family-friendly destination offering a welcoming and inclusive environment for all visitors. With amenities such as a gender-neutral restroom and a commitment to being an LGBTQ+ friendly and transgender-safe space, the farm is known for creating a warm and accessible holiday experience. Debit payments are accepted for convenience.

Families can enjoy roaming the manicured fields to select from a variety of trees, including blue spruce and many sizes to suit different homes. Saws are provided for u-cut customers, and wagon pickup is available to transport trees back from the fields. Guests are also treated to hot chocolate and the cozy atmosphere of a wood-burning stove after their outing, adding to the festive spirit.

Visitors consistently highlight the farm’s friendly and helpful staff, quality trees, and thoughtful touches such as wagon rides, tree wrapping, and even small moments like children feeding the farm’s horses. With its combination of inclusivity, tradition, and community spirit, Whispering Willow Christmas Tree Farm has become a cherished holiday destination for many returning families year after year.

farms.name: Vivian Plantation
farms.description:
Vivian Plantation has been family-owned and operated by three generations of the Grose family since 1947. Over the decades, the farm has reclaimed once non-arable land into thriving woodland, now spanning 30 acres, and has harvested more than 60,000 trees. Originally a wholesale supplier, the farm expanded in 1965 to include both retail pre-harvested trees and cut-your-own options, making it a cherished destination for Christmas traditions.

Visitors can enjoy more than just finding the perfect tree. The plantation offers hot chocolate, spiced apple cider, and log fires for warming up, along with marshmallow roasting and picnic tables for families who wish to linger. Staff assist by shaking loose needles, baling trees, and helping load them at no extra cost, with twine and tree bags provided for convenience.

Dog-friendly (on leash) and welcoming to all, Vivian Plantation also features a self-portrait station to capture festive memories. With its combination of history, hospitality, and woodland charm, the plantation has remained a trusted holiday destination for over 75 years.

farms.name: Thomas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Thomas Tree Farm is a family-friendly destination located just south of Ottawa, set on a scenic 50-acre property near North Gower. Visitors can wander through the maple bush or take a tractor-drawn wagon ride to the fields to select their perfect Christmas tree. The farm offers a wide variety of cut-your-own options, including balsam fir and spruce (6–10 feet) and Scotch pine (6–8 feet). For convenience, pre-cut trees are also available, with balsam firs up to 13 feet, Fraser firs up to 9 feet, and smaller balsam and spruce options between 3–6 feet.

The experience extends beyond the trees, with complimentary hot chocolate and homemade cookies served by the fire pits after tree selection. Families can also browse hand-made evergreen wreaths, festive boughs, and enjoy the children’s play area. Guests are encouraged to dress warmly and wear proper footwear for the winter conditions, and hand saws are available for use on-site.

With its combination of beautiful trees, festive extras, and welcoming atmosphere, Thomas Tree Farm offers a complete holiday tradition that brings families back year after year.

farms.name: The Perfect Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
The Perfect Christmas Tree Farm offers a straightforward, no-frills tree-cutting experience across two convenient locations—the scenic farm and a Dairy Queen lot. Open daily from November 23 to December 24, the farm provides families, friends, and pets with the chance to pick from a wide variety of trees, including balsam, spruce, Fraser fir, and pine.

Visitors can select and cut their own tree for a flat fee, with baling provided to make transport easy. For added convenience, delivery is available throughout the Greater Toronto Area. The farm accepts cash payments only.

Guests appreciate the friendly staff, large selection, and the simplicity of the process. Known for its accessibility and reliable supply—“we will never run out of trees”—The Perfect Christmas Tree Farm is a dependable choice for those who value a classic, do-it-yourself holiday tradition.

farms.name: The Christmas Farm
farms.description:
The Christmas Farm is a family-run operation in the Kingston area, founded in 2012 by Jim and Deni after their retirement from over 30 years of service each in the Canadian Armed Forces. Alongside their son Joe, they planted their first 1,000 trees with the dream of creating a place where families could build holiday traditions and lasting memories.

The farm is rooted in community spirit, having raised thousands of dollars for local charities such as the Loughborough Christmas and Emergency Relief Fund, New Leaf Link, the South Frontenac Food Bank, and the Canadian Cancer Society. Visitors are welcomed with warmth and personal attention, whether it’s Jim’s down-home guidance in finding the perfect tree, Deni’s joy in seeing families return year after year, or Joe’s keen eye for helping guests select just the right one.

With its strong values, quality trees, and dedication to giving back, The Christmas Farm is more than just a place to buy a tree—it’s a destination for holiday tradition and community connection.

farms.name: Spademan Tree Farm
farms.description:
Spade Tree Farm is a family-run destination in Port Perry, Ontario, offering a traditional cut-your-own Christmas tree experience. The farm grows a variety of species—including white spruce, blue spruce, white pine, balsam fir, and Fraser fir—without the use of pesticides or chemicals. Customers can borrow hand saws provided on-site or bring their own, while motorized saws are not permitted.

The farm is dog-friendly for leashed pets and also welcomes photographers, with weekday sessions available by arrangement.

More than just a place to buy a tree, Spade Tree Farm emphasizes creating lasting memories and traditions. Families are invited to enjoy the natural setting, warm by the fire, and capture special moments in the fields of evergreens.

farms.name: Snyder's Family Farm
farms.description:
Snyder’s Family Farm is a festive holiday destination located just minutes from Kitchener, Ontario, offering u-cut and pre-cut Christmas trees alongside a wide range of seasonal activities. With over 10,000 trees to choose from, families can cut their own tree (any size for $90 + tax, saws provided) or select from premium pre-cut options ($100 + tax).

The farm is decorated for the season and provides a complete Christmas experience. Guests can visit Santa at the North Pole, shop for gifts and décor in the Christmas Gift Barn, and enjoy fresh baked goods and festive drinks at the Farm Bakery and Sugar Plum Patio. Cozy private campfires are also available with advance booking.

Known for its warm hospitality and family atmosphere, Snyder’s consistently earns praise for its friendly staff, festive décor, and abundant photo opportunities. With a tradition of offering both fun and farm-fresh trees, Snyder’s Family Farm has become a favorite destination for making holiday memories year after year.

farms.name: Sloan's Christmas Village
farms.description:
Sloan’s Christmas Village is a family-owned destination with deep roots in Bothwell, Ontario. The tradition began in 1950, when William and Jean Sloan sold pine and spruce trees from their front yard. By popular request, the u-cut experience was introduced, and in 1998 Sloan’s established a permanent location on Zone Road #7. Today, the farm is run by John and Sheila Sloan, who continue to preserve the forest and cultivate premium Christmas trees, including the popular Fraser Fir, prized for its fragrance and needle retention.

Sloan’s has grown far beyond a tree farm into a full holiday village, offering more than a dozen activities, hundreds of campfires, and a vibrant marketplace of local vendors. Families can enjoy wagon rides, games, and festive entertainment, making the farm a favorite destination for holiday outings, company parties, and seasonal celebrations. Since 2010, Sloan’s has also hosted school field trips, blending fun and education with outdoor learning in the Carolinian forest.

In 2020, Sloan’s expanded with a second village to welcome more guests and now also offers summer activities. With its blend of history, innovation, and festive spirit, Sloan’s Christmas Village has become one of Ontario’s most beloved holiday destinations, bringing joy to families year after year.

farms.name: Scheers Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Scheers Christmas Trees is a family-run farm specializing exclusively in Fraser firs, prized for their outstanding needle retention, rich fragrance, and strong, elegant branches. For over a decade, the Scheers family has been cultivating these beautiful trees, offering cut-your-own options up to 8 feet tall at a flat rate of $70 (tax included). Complimentary shaking and baling are provided to make transport easy.

Visitors enjoy more than just the trees—Scheers creates a warm, festive atmosphere complete with hot apple cider, homemade Belgian cookies, and a cozy, wood-heated outbuilding decorated for the holidays. Families can also take photos with Santa, adding to the seasonal magic. The farm supplies hand saws for cutting, welcomes custom appointments outside regular hours, and offers Fraser fir boughs for planters and décor.

Customers consistently praise the friendly family service, high-quality trees, and the inviting holiday experience. With its focus on premium Fraser firs and memorable traditions, Scheers Christmas Trees has become a cherished destination for families who return year after year.

farms.name: Robinson Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Robinson Christmas Trees is a family-run farm in Ariss, Ontario, offering a welcoming atmosphere and a well-tended selection of fresh, high-quality trees. Customers can choose from white spruce (6–9’), along with limited numbers of white pine and balsam fir (7–11’). Most trees are priced between $65–$75, with smaller trees also available. Sale trees are clearly marked with ribbons, while unmarked trees are still maturing for future seasons.

Visitors can bring their own saw or borrow one from the farm, with the option to have staff assist in cutting. Customers are encouraged to bring a tarp or cord for transport, as bags or netting are not provided. In addition to trees, Robinson’s offers handmade wreaths and swags crafted from farm-fresh greenery, each unique and natural. Dogs on leashes are welcome, and payment is accepted by cash or e-transfer.

Guests consistently praise the friendly owners, fair prices, and carefully pruned trees that last well into the season. With its mix of quality, charm, and tradition, Robinson Christmas Trees has become a favorite holiday stop for many families year after year.

farms.name: Rinas Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Rinas Christmas Trees is a sprawling, family-friendly farm offering acres of beautifully maintained trees with plenty of variety to suit every home. Customers can choose from pine, spruce, fir, and even the unique concolor fir—a specialty species not commonly found elsewhere. With so many options in height, width, and species, families enjoy wandering the fields to find “the one,” making tree-hunting a fun and memorable tradition.

The farm keeps things simple and affordable, with flat-rate pricing of $83 per tree (cash only), plus a small fee for netting. Every tree is shaken to remove loose needles, and wrapping is available to make transport easier. Guests also appreciate the inviting atmosphere, from the tractor rides to the fields to the cozy barn offering hot drinks and sweet treats.

Visitors consistently highlight the vast selection, fair pricing, and welcoming staff who make the experience smooth and enjoyable. With its combination of quality trees, festive extras, and unbeatable value, Rinas Christmas Trees has become a go-to destination for families returning year after year.

farms.name: Powell's Trees
farms.description:
Powell’s Trees is a family-run farm just an hour from Toronto, offering a wide selection of Christmas trees in all shapes, sizes, and species—including the often hard-to-find pine. Guests can choose between pre-cut options or the classic cut-your-own experience, with a simple flat-rate price for all trees.

The farm is known for its welcoming atmosphere and festive touches. Families can warm up with hot apple cider, browse handmade charcuterie boards, candles, garlands, and woodcrafts created by the owners, and even enjoy tobogganing on the property’s hills—a tradition many visitors say is worth the trip alone. Saws are provided for convenience, but bringing a toboggan is highly recommended to make hauling trees (and enjoying the slopes) easier.

Customers consistently praise the friendly owners, excellent prices, and high-quality trees, returning year after year to continue the tradition. With its combination of beautiful trees, family hospitality, and festive extras, Powell’s Trees has become a cherished destination for holiday outings.

farms.name: Potash Creek Farms
farms.description:
Potash Creek Farms is a family-run farm in Omemee, Ontario, established in 2006. Specializing in Christmas trees, handcrafted wreaths, and greenery, the farm offers both pre-harvested and cut-your-own options in a variety of species and sizes. With a focus on fostering tradition, Potash Creek has become a trusted local source of holiday greenery and proudly partners with community groups to support and strengthen the region.

The farm is committed to sustainable land stewardship. Natural ground cover is maintained between tree rows to promote soil health and reduce erosion, mowing is limited, and integrated pest management is used to minimize chemical inputs. More than half of the property is preserved as forests and wetlands, protecting biodiversity and ensuring a healthy landscape for future generations.

Visitors are welcomed to enjoy the rolling hills and scenic views while finding the perfect tree. With its combination of environmental care, community values, and festive offerings, Potash Creek Farms provides families with a meaningful and memorable holiday tradition.

farms.name: Pillar and Pines
farms.description:
Pillar and Pines is a welcoming Christmas tree farm where families are invited to create lasting holiday traditions. Known for its festive and family-friendly atmosphere, the farm has become a place where many visitors return each year to take photos, cut their own tree, and make memories together.

After selecting the perfect tree, guests can warm up at the Cocoa Hut, enjoying complimentary hot chocolate and candy canes around a cozy fire. Saws are available on-site for cutting, though guests are welcome to bring their own. The farm is also dog-friendly, with leashed pets welcome to join in the fun.

Open rain or shine, Pillar and Pines blends beautiful trees, thoughtful touches, and a spirit of hospitality, making it a cherished holiday destination for families year after year.

farms.name: Merry Farms
farms.description:
Merry Farms is a 176-acre family-run farm that has become a beloved destination for holiday traditions and seasonal fun. Originally planted with Christmas trees in the 1970s by the Wills family, the land was purchased in 2013 by the current owners, who transitioned from passionate hobby farmers to full-time farming life. What started as a dream has grown into a thriving operation where families return year after year to create lasting memories.

The farm offers a classic cut-your-own Christmas tree experience, with beautifully cared-for fields and a wide selection of trees. With up to 65 seasonal staff helping during peak times, Merry Farms ensures a smooth, welcoming experience for every visitor. The family is deeply committed to replanting trees each spring, keeping the land vibrant and the tradition alive for future generations.

Beyond Christmas, Pumpkinfest has become a highlight of the fall season. First launched in 2015 after a modest roadside pumpkin sale, the event has grown into a community favourite, complete with activities, family fun, and plenty of pumpkins. Each year, Merry Farms continues to expand its offerings, adding new attractions to delight visitors.

With its blend of history, hard work, and a genuine love for farming, Merry Farms has established itself as a year-round destination where families can celebrate seasonal traditions in a beautiful countryside setting.

farms.name: Mark's Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Mark’s Christmas Trees offers a rustic and eco-friendly Christmas tree experience in Millgrove, Ontario. Proudly free of herbicides and pesticides, the farm maintains its trees naturally, making it a unique choice for families who value sustainability and the charm of a woodland setting. Instead of rows of perfectly shaped trees, visitors can explore the woods to find a tree with character—perfect for a corner, wall, or those seeking something special and unique.

Open weekends in December from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. (and weekdays by appointment), the farm provides a wide selection of fresh Christmas greens, including swags, wreaths, planters, and festive arrangements at reasonable prices. Guests are encouraged to bring their own saws, though saws can be borrowed if needed. Wrapping is available for $5, and payment is accepted by cash or e-transfer (with cash preferred due to spotty internet).

Tree pricing is straightforward and inclusive of tax, starting at $80 for trees up to 5 feet and ranging to $130 for trees up to 10 feet, with larger trees priced incrementally. Visitors are advised to arrive by 3 p.m. to ensure enough daylight to find and cut their tree, and to dress warmly for comfort.

With its natural approach, welcoming atmosphere, and dog-friendly policy, Mark’s Christmas Trees is ideal for those who want a more authentic, environmentally conscious Christmas tree tradition.

farms.name: Madeira Farms
farms.description:
Madeira Farms in Rockwood, Ontario, has been welcoming families to create Christmas traditions since 2004. What began with a roadside sign and hot cider served from a humble lean-to has grown into a cherished annual destination, now anchored by a beautiful timber-frame Shoppe. Many of the families who visited that first year still return, making the farm part of their holiday tradition.

The farm offers both cut-your-own trees—including pine, spruce, and fir—and Ontario-grown pre-cut Fraser and Balsam firs. To make the experience easy and enjoyable, saws and sleds are provided, and the Shoppe features handcrafted wreaths and sturdy tree stands for holiday decorating.

With its peaceful cedar bush and snow-covered fields, Madeira Farms remains a place of quiet seasonal beauty. Whether cutting your own tree or choosing a pre-cut option, families leave with more than just a Christmas tree—they leave with cherished memories.

farms.name: Little Lake Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Little Lake Christmas Trees is a family-run farm operated by the Smyth family, dedicated to providing a warm and memorable Christmas experience. Visitors are welcomed with festive touches like hot chocolate, candy canes, and homemade cookies, making the outing as enjoyable as finding the perfect tree.

The farm offers an impressive selection of trees, ranging from classic 5–6 foot sizes to towering 12–13 foot specimens. Families can stroll through the fields and cut their own tree, with sleds recommended for easier transport, especially on snowy days. In addition to trees, fresh wreaths are also available, adding a festive accent to holiday décor.

Guests consistently highlight the friendly service, beautiful setting, and Hallmark-movie atmosphere, with many families making Little Lake Christmas Trees an annual tradition for generations. With its combination of quality trees, thoughtful extras, and genuine hospitality, the farm provides a complete holiday experience worth the drive.

farms.name: Little Creek Tree Farm
farms.description:
Little Creek Tree Farm, owned and operated by Tom and Christin Ebert, is located just outside London, Ontario. With Tom’s diploma in Landscape Design from Fanshawe College and more than 30 years of experience in the tree industry, the farm has been providing high-quality trees and professional service since its founding in 2005. Over the years, the Eberts have planted more than 5,000 trees, serving both residential and commercial clients.

The farm specializes in Christmas trees, landscaping trees, and shrubs, offering services that range from schoolyard greening projects to large-scale planting in parks and private yards. Known for their careful attention to detail, timely work, and exceptional customer service, the team at Little Creek Tree Farm has earned praise from organizations like ReForest London as well as countless individual customers.

Families can also visit the farm during the holiday season to purchase Christmas trees, along with cedars and other evergreens, enjoying a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. With excellent selection, fair pricing, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction, Little Creek Tree Farm has become a trusted name in both landscaping and seasonal traditions across the London area.

farms.name: Leos Tree Farm
farms.description:
Leo’s Tree Farm has been growing memories since 1996, offering families a warm and festive Christmas tradition for over 20 years. Known for its passion for quality trees and welcoming atmosphere, the farm provides both pre-cut options and the classic cut-your-own experience in its scenic bush lots.

Visitors are invited to enjoy the full holiday experience, beginning with the rustic, wood-heated shack where complimentary hot chocolate is served. Guests can also stay a little longer to take part in chestnut roasting, a signature feature that has become a cherished highlight of the farm.

In addition to trees, Leo’s Tree Farm offers decorative swags for sale and even the materials for those who wish to create their own. Families are welcome to explore the property on nature walks, with leashed pets encouraged to join the outing.

With its blend of festive traditions, natural beauty, and thoughtful extras, Leo’s Tree Farm has become a go-to destination for those looking to build lasting family memories during the holiday season.

farms.name: Laura's Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Laura’s Christmas Trees has been a family-operated tree farm since 1986, offering a welcoming, family-oriented atmosphere and a wide selection of quality Christmas trees. Operating as a cash-only farm, Laura’s also features handcrafted art and décor, landscaping trees, and additional services, making it more than just a place to find a tree.

Visitors can explore over two kilometers of walking trails, adding a peaceful outdoor experience to their holiday outing. On weekends in December, guests are treated to complimentary hot chocolate, candy canes, and dog treats (while supplies last). The farm is also dog-friendly, with leashes left to the discretion of owners, making it easy to bring the whole family along.

With its long history, friendly service, and thoughtful extras, Laura’s Christmas Trees provides both a festive outing and a touch of local artistry, continuing a tradition that has welcomed families for nearly four decades.

farms.name: Karlson Evergreens Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Karlson Evergreens has been a cherished part of Ottawa’s holiday traditions for more than 30 years. Owner Karl began selling Christmas trees in 1983 at the age of 27, starting with pre-cut lots across the Ottawa area. In 1990, together with his wife Sonya, he opened Karlson Evergreens—offering just three species of trees that first season.

Today, the farm proudly provides six different species of Christmas trees from around the world, chosen for their breathtaking colour, fullness, fragrance, and excellent needle retention. Karl and Sonya’s mission has always been to make it possible for families to enjoy a tree that lasts beautifully throughout the holiday season, without the hassle of constant upkeep.

Each year, weeks of care and preparation go into hand-trimming every tree to ensure natural shape and fullness. To keep the farm thriving, seedlings are planted each spring to replace trees cut the previous year—safeguarding the tradition for generations to come.

At Karlson Evergreens, you’ll find not just a tree, but a lovingly cultivated part of your family’s Christmas celebration.

farms.name: Jingle Bills Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Welcome to Jingle Bills Christmas Tree Farm—Southern Ontario’s very own North Pole! Conveniently located just 15 minutes north of Burlington/Hamilton and 5 minutes south of Guelph in Puslinch County, Jingle Bills is your one-stop shop for fun, friends, and Christmas spirit.

The farm sits on 100 acres, including 30 acres of dense forest and a babbling brook, making the perfect backdrop for your holiday adventure. Families can search for their perfect tree, bring out the saw, and create memories that last a lifetime. Afterward, explore the Elves Marketplace, grab a treat from Jingle Deb’s Treat Tent, or let the kids enjoy the inflatable Farm Hopper Barnyard. Cozy fires and hot cocoa add to the festive atmosphere.

farms.description:
J Ayers Trees and Landscaping in Orillia offers families a festive and welcoming destination to find their perfect Christmas tree. Known for its wide selection of beautifully shaped spruce and fir trees, the farm has become a cherished annual tradition for many families in the area.

Visitors can enjoy more than just trees—free hot chocolate, a warm bonfire, and friendly farm animals like goats, bunnies, and birds add to the charm of the experience. Customers consistently praise the helpful service and the family-friendly atmosphere that makes every visit memorable.

Whether it’s your first time or a returning tradition, J Ayers Trees provides not only fresh, affordable trees but also the chance to create lasting holiday memories in a truly festive setting.

farms.name: Hope’s Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
Nestled on the scenic Oak Ridges Moraine in Enniskillen, Ontario, Hope’s Christmas Tree Farm offers families a warm and festive holiday escape. Visitors can stroll the farm, choose a hand-picked Christmas tree, and enjoy a cozy seasonal atmosphere complete with fresh greenery, hot drinks, and the work of local artisans showcased in the farm’s historic 18th-century barn. Special touches like pre-booked visits with Santa and friendly farm animals make the experience even more memorable.

Founded by Dan and Rebecca Hope, university sweethearts with a background in environmental studies, the farm reflects their shared passion for the outdoors and dedication to sustainability. Since planting their first tree in 2010, the Hopes have worked tirelessly to grow their dream into a family-friendly destination that officially opened in 2020.

From the moment guests step onto the farm, they are invited to “watch us grow” and share in the timeless tradition of choosing a Christmas tree in a charming country setting.

farms.name: Hockley Valley Farm
farms.description:
Located in the scenic Hockley Valley, this family-owned farm blends a love of the land with a deep commitment to community and tradition. Owners Jason and Vikki realized their dream of leaving suburban life behind to embrace the serenity of country living. Jason, a lifelong draft horse enthusiast, can often be found driving his beloved Percherons, Ike and Duke, while Vikki brings her background in social services and customer care to create a welcoming environment for all visitors.

Their three children are also actively involved in caring for the animals and helping maintain the property, making it truly a family-run operation. With a foundation built on hard work, hospitality, and a love of the countryside, Hockley Valley Farm is a place where guests are welcomed to share in the peace and beauty of the valley while supporting a family passionate about farm life.

farms.name: Hillcrest Tree Farm
farms.description:
Situated on a historic 100-acre former dairy farm dating back to the 1800s, Hillcrest Tree Farm has been family-owned and operated since 1987. Dave and Bronwyn Harper transformed the once-abandoned property into a thriving Christmas tree farm, planting their first trees in 1993 and welcoming the public in 2000.

What began with a modest setup—using a section of the drive shed and a pickup truck—has grown into a well-established farm featuring an indoor tree lot housed in a 40 x 60-foot Coverall building. Visitors are welcomed each season to stroll the scenic property, choose their tree, and enjoy the warm, family-oriented atmosphere that Hillcrest is known for.

Blending history, hard work, and community spirit, Hillcrest Tree Farm remains a cherished destination for families creating Christmas traditions year after year.

farms.name: Hendry's Christmas Tree Farm
farms.description:
For generations, Hendry’s Christmas Tree Farm has been the go-to destination for families seeking the perfect holiday tree near Smiths Falls. Known for its warm, welcoming atmosphere and beautifully cared-for trees, the farm makes the classic Christmas tradition easy and memorable. Guests can even drive right in to pick their tree, avoiding the long walks often required at larger farms.

Beyond trees, Hendry’s offers a charming country store filled with holiday delights, including homemade jams, honey, and unique gifts. Families return year after year, not only for the quality trees but also for the heartfelt hospitality that makes every visit special.

Whether you’re starting a new tradition or continuing one, Hendry’s Christmas Tree Farm is the perfect place to create lasting holiday memories.

Rusty Gate Christmas Tree Farm is a family property with deep roots, passed down through generations, that began its journey into Christmas tree farming in 2015. Knowing the patience required...since trees grow only about a foot per year—the family planted, pruned, and carefully tended their trees for years before welcoming the public for the first time in 2022.

Today, Rusty Gate offers families the chance to start new holiday traditions in a farm setting built on dedication and care. With years of work behind every tree, the farm reflects both heritage and hard work, making it a meaningful destination for those seeking a fresh, locally grown Christmas tree.

farms.name: Sandpiper Tree Farm
farms.description:
Sandpiper Tree Farm is a family-run destination where visitors can enjoy the classic tradition of cutting their own Christmas tree. With a wide selection of well-shaped trees in various sizes, families can wander through the fields to find their perfect tree, with saws available for use on-site. Customers consistently praise the fresh, long-lasting trees, reasonable prices, and the warm, welcoming service that keeps them returning year after year.

In addition to trees, guests are invited to stop by The Milk House Boutique, which features handcrafted ornaments, artwork, and seasonal décor...perfect for adding a unique touch to the holidays. Children leave with a candy cane, adding a small but memorable tradition to the outing.

Blending quality trees, friendly service, and a touch of local craftsmanship, Sandpiper Tree Farm has become a beloved part of many families’ Christmas traditions.

farms.name: Zuhoski Farms
farms.description:
Zuhoski Farms is a family-owned and operated tree farm spanning 70 acres of meticulously maintained nursery stock in Cutchogue, NY. Specializing in cut-your-own Christmas trees across 15 dedicated acres, the farm provides visitors with an authentic tree-harvesting experience while ensuring accessibility for all guests through wheelchair-accessible entrances. The farm's diverse selection includes numerous evergreen varieties alongside specialty nursery plants such as American Arborvitae, Blue Diamond Spruce, various Boxwood cultivars, and decorative options like Crape Myrtle and Holly varieties.

Beyond its impressive inventory of trees and plants, Zuhoski Farms offers visitors a genuine agricultural experience deeply rooted in family tradition. The expansive property provides ample space for selecting the perfect Christmas tree or browsing through their extensive collection of nursery plants for landscaping projects. With its combination of quality stock, personalized service, and commitment to accessibility, Zuhoski Farms stands as a premier destination for both holiday traditions and year-round plant enthusiasts seeking expert guidance and superior greenery.

farms.name: Woody Acres
farms.description:
Established in 1995, Woody Acres is a premier Christmas tree farm offering both cut-your-own and pre-cut options for holiday shoppers. The farm features an impressive variety of six different tree species, including Fraser Fir, Douglas Fir, Concolor Fir (White Fir), Canaan Fir, Colorado Blue Spruce, and Balsam Fir, ensuring customers can find the perfect centerpiece for their holiday celebrations. Woody Acres provides a complete holiday experience with convenient amenities including free parking and a playground for younger visitors.

Beyond tree selection, Woody Acres enhances the holiday shopping experience with their on-site gift shop featuring handcrafted wreaths and other seasonal decorations. The picturesque setting makes for ideal holiday photography opportunities, allowing families to capture memorable moments while selecting their Christmas tree. For over 25 years, Woody Acres has maintained its commitment to quality trees and creating a warm, festive atmosphere where holiday traditions can be formed and cherished year after year.

farms.name: Airfield Farms
farms.description:
Airfield Farms, established in 2018, offers a memorable Christmas tree experience with both cut-your-own and pre-cut options for holiday shoppers. This wheelchair accessible destination provides convenient amenities including free parking and multiple payment options, accepting both credit and debit cards. Visitors can also browse a selection of festive wreaths to complement their perfect Christmas tree, creating a complete holiday decorating solution.

The farm creates a welcoming atmosphere for families and photographers alike, with seasonal photo shoot opportunities available by appointment. Airfield Farms takes pride in supporting other small businesses in the community while maintaining a professional, customer-oriented approach to their operations. Their commitment to accessibility and customer convenience has quickly established them as a valued holiday tradition destination since their founding just a few years ago.

farms.name: ANTHONYS CHRISTMAS TREES
farms.description:
Anthony's Christmas Trees invites families to experience the joy of cutting their own Christmas tree in a welcoming, wheelchair-accessible environment. Opening November 29th, this festive destination provides everything needed for a seamless tree-hunting experience, including complimentary saws, tree shaking to remove loose needles, precision drilling for perfect stand placement, and convenient tree wrapping with twine to protect your selection during transport home.

Beyond the tree-cutting experience, Anthony's Christmas Trees offers a complete holiday package with high-quality wreaths and practical accessories including tree stands and protective tree bags. The farm prides itself on its customer-focused services and straightforward pricing structure, with all sales tax included for a hassle-free shopping experience. Cash and checks are accepted, allowing customers to focus on what truly mattersâcreating cherished holiday memories while selecting the perfect centerpiece for their Christmas celebrations.

farms.name: Bailey Family Christmas Trees
farms.description:
Bailey Family Christmas Trees has been creating cherished holiday memories since 1967, when the Bailey family first planted a thousand seedlings to establish what would become a beloved seasonal tradition in the community. For over five decades, this family-owned farm has specialized in offering a complete cut-your-own tree experience, allowing visitors to select their perfect Christmas centerpiece while enjoying the festive atmosphere of a working tree farm.

Beyond the experience of selecting and cutting a fresh Christmas tree, Bailey Family Christmas Trees provides a range of seasonal amenities designed to enhance the holiday experience. Visitors can enjoy traditional wagon rides through the picturesque farm, arrange special visits with Santa for the children, and browse a selection of handcrafted wreaths in various styles and sizes. With convenient parking and a warm, welcoming atmosphere, the Bailey family continues their commitment to providing the highest quality trees and a wholesome family experience that has become a holiday tradition for generations of customers.

farms.name: Bauman's Farm Market & Greenhouses
farms.description:
Bauman's Farm Market & Greenhouses, established in 1908, offers a comprehensive selection of seasonal products and services from its expansive 200-acre property spanning Penfield and Webster. Located at the corner of Five Mile Line Road and Plank Road in Penfield, this family-owned business provides customers with a diverse range of tree varieties including Balsam Fir, Douglas Fir, Concolor Fir, Colorado Blue Spruce, and White Spruce. The market features both pre-cut trees and cut-your-own options, complemented by handcrafted wreaths and seasonal refreshments including hot chocolate and cider.

Visitors to Bauman's can explore 21 greenhouses filled with quality plants while enjoying the warm, community-oriented atmosphere cultivated by locally hired staff members. farms.description:
Al-Dor Farms is a family-run farm in Glen Valley, just 5 km east of historic Fort Langley. Albert and Dorothy Anderson bought the land in 1971, and by 1988, they had placed a small sign and an honour-system jar at the end of the road to sell pumpkins. What began as a simple roadside idea quickly grew into a beloved local tradition, complete with tractor-drawn hayrides and hands-on farm experiences.

Today, the Anderson family continues that legacy, welcoming visitors year-round with a focus on family-friendly fun, hands-on education, and friendly farm animals. The farm hosts a variety of seasonal events:

- Spring & Summer – school tours, birthday parties, private and corporate events
- Easter, Mother’s Day & Father’s Day – public openings with festive farm activities
- Fall – the Pumpkin Patch & Seasonal Market, offering fresh corn, U-pick sunflowers, pumpkins, sausages, artisan products, and farm animals
- December – a Christmas market and Christmas trees, complete with farm animals, hot chocolate, marshmallows by the campfire, and festive cheer.

From pumpkins to Christmas trees, from hayrides to holiday markets, Al-Dor Farms is dedicated to creating experiences where families can connect with nature, celebrate traditions, and make lasting memories.

Opening for the 2024 season on November 14, Plantation des Noëls d’antan invites families to enjoy a festive and traditional Christmas tree outing. Visitors can wander the fields to choose from hundreds of trees of all sizes and shapes, borrow a saw and sled, and have their tree wrapped for easy transport. A new feature this year allows guests to bring headlamps and select their tree after nightfall, creating a magical experience under the stars.

The plantation also emphasizes sharing knowledge and passion for Christmas traditions. Guests can visit the boutique and enjoy interpretive displays in the fields, learning more about tree cultivation and holiday heritage. With its blend of tradition, family fun, and educational experiences, Plantation des Noëls d’antan offers a memorable way to celebrate the season.

French:
À compter du 14 novembre 2024, la Plantation des Noëls d’antan ouvre ses portes pour une nouvelle saison festive de cueillette de sapins. Les visiteurs peuvent se promener en famille dans les champs, choisir parmi des centaines d’arbres de toutes tailles, emprunter scie et traîneau, et repartir avec leur arbre emballé pour faciliter le transport. Nouveauté cette année : apportez vos lampes frontales et venez choisir votre arbre après la tombée de la nuit, pour une expérience magique sous les étoiles.

La plantation met aussi de l’avant le partage des savoirs et des traditions. Une visite à la boutique ainsi qu’une randonnée aux champs permettent d’en apprendre davantage sur la culture des sapins de Noël et les coutumes du temps des Fêtes, grâce à une série d’affiches d’interprétation. Avec son ambiance champêtre et son approche éducative, la Plantation des Noëls d’antan offre une expérience familiale unique qui ravive la magie de Noël.

farms.description:
French:
Venez vivre une expérience d’autocueillette de sapins baumiers dans une ambiance festive et chaleureuse. Pour un prix minimum de 100 $, choisissez le sapin parfait pour votre foyer selon le forfait sélectionné lors de votre réservation. Chaque visite inclut l’emballage de votre arbre, l’accès à un espace de feu de camp pour vous réchauffer, et une boisson chaude au choix — un chocolat chaud réconfortant ou un bouillon de poulet revigorant. Vous êtes également invités à apporter vos propres collations et à immortaliser vos moments dans la zone photo prévue à cet effet.

Les réservations sont obligatoires, avec des plages horaires disponibles de 10h à 12h ou de 13h à 15h, les 23, 24, 30 novembre et le 1er décembre 2024. Une soirée VIP exclusive est aussi offerte le 30 novembre de 17h à 21h30, pour une expérience encore plus magique.

Veuillez noter que seuls les paiements en argent comptant sont acceptés. Le guichet automatique le plus proche se trouve à Lacolle (12 km).

farms.name: Hadley Christmas Trees / Arbres de Noël
farms.description:
? English
Located in the foothills of the Laurentians, just one hour north of Montreal, Hadley Christmas Trees offers the classic holiday tradition of choosing and cutting your own tree—or selecting from fresh precut Balsam and Fraser Firs at the barn. With thousands of well-cultivated, bushy trees to choose from, families are sure to find their perfect match.

Every tree purchase includes sales tax, round-trip transportation to and from the fields, baling, and hot chocolate for the whole family. Guests can also warm up in the festive Christmas shop, where local foods, crafts, tree stands, and tree-care products are available.

Whether you prefer the fragrant softness of a traditional Quebec Balsam Fir or the silvery sheen and strong branches of a Fraser Fir, Hadley provides an authentic countryside Christmas experience. Photographers are also welcome to use the farm as a backdrop for seasonal family photos.

? Open weekends in December.

? Français
Située dans les contreforts des Laurentides, à seulement une heure au nord de Montréal, la Sapinière Hadley vous invite à vivre la tradition de Noël en choisissant et coupant votre propre arbre, ou en sélectionnant un sapin Baumier ou Fraser fraîchement coupé à la grange. Avec des milliers de sapins bien cultivés et touffus, chaque famille trouvera l’arbre parfait.

Chaque achat inclut la taxe de vente, le transport aller-retour du champ, l’emballage de l’arbre et un chocolat chaud pour toute la famille. Réchauffez-vous ensuite dans la boutique de Noël où vous trouverez des produits locaux, de l’artisanat, des supports à sapin et des produits d’entretien.

Que vous choisissiez le parfum enivrant du sapin baumier du Québec ou l’élégance argentée et les branches solides du Fraser, Hadley vous offre une expérience authentique de Noël à la campagne. Les photographes sont également les bienvenus pour utiliser la sapinière comme décor pour leurs séances photos familiales.

? Ouvert les fins de semaine de décembre.

farms.name: Calvin Lutz Farms
farms.description:
Calvin Lutz Farms, established in 1895, is a historic family-operated Christmas tree farm nestled in the picturesque landscape of Northwest Michigan near Kaleva in Manistee County. With over 125 years of agricultural heritage, the farm offers customers a complete holiday experience with both cut-your-own and pre-cut Christmas tree options. Visitors can select from an impressive variety of premium trees including Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir, Douglas Fir, Noble Fir, Grand Fir, Eastern White Pine, Scotch Pine, and Colorado Blue Spruce, ensuring the perfect centerpiece for any holiday celebration.

Beyond exceptional trees, Calvin Lutz Farms provides handcrafted wreaths to complement customers' holiday decorating needs. The farm features wheelchair accessible entrance and parking, making the Christmas tree selection experience inclusive for all visitors. Originally founded by Matthew Lutz, an immigrant from Germany, the farm evolved over generations from cattle farming to its current focus on Christmas trees and seasonal produce. Today, Calvin Lutz Farms continues its tradition of excellence while creating memorable experiences for families seeking to establish or continue their own holiday traditions in Michigan's beautiful north country.
